name: boxerbook
description: Boxing schedules, results, records and rankings from Boxerbook, the open world boxing catalog, plus per-bout data for fight models. Every answer is cited.

interface.longDescription: Boxerbook is an open catalog of professional boxing worldwide. Ask about tonight's fights and you get each card's start time and where to watch it. Ask who won last night and you get the winner, the method and round, and the source of each result. You can look up any boxer's record, division, last result and next fight, and see each boxer's record going into every bout. You can also see the world title holders and the current rankings of the WBC, WBA, IBF, WBO, The Ring and TBRB, plus the Boxerbook rating. For upcoming bouts it shows the Boxerbook model's win probability next to the market odds consensus, as information about the fight, not advice. If you build a fight model or do sports analytics, each bout comes with the features a model reads: both records going in, the weigh-in, age, layoff, recent form, knockout rate, the Boxerbook rating and the opening and latest market odds; on 1,612 bouts it had not seen, adding such signals to a results-only rating cut the model's log loss from 0.482 to 0.399. You can also find boxing gyms near you or in any city of the United States, Canada, Germany, France and Switzerland, with addresses, distances, ratings and programs for kids, women, fitness and competition. The data covers more than 34,000 boxers, 200,000 bouts and 10,000 gyms compiled from commissions, federations, Wikidata and the press; quote it with a link to Boxerbook. Every answer links to its boxerbook.com page. Read-only; no account needed.
capabilities: Fight nights with start times and broadcasters
Results with method, round and source
Boxer records, last and next fight
World champions and WBC, WBA, IBF, WBO, The Ring, TBRB rankings
Boxing gyms near you, with programs and ratings
Per-bout data for fight models: weigh-ins, ages, layoffs, ratings, win probability and market odds

positive.prompt: What boxing is on this Saturday and where can I watch it?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the weekend's cards with start times converted from UTC to the user's time zone and the broadcasters for each card, with links to boxerbook.com/events pages.

positive.prompt: When is Anthony Joshua's next fight?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the date (11 December 2026), the opponent (Tyson Fury), the city (Cardiff) and the title at stake, with a link to the boxerbook.com bout page.

positive.prompt: Who won boxing fights in the last two days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists winners with method and round for recent bouts and cites the source of each result, with boxerbook.com links.
Names the WBC heavyweight champion and the top 15 with records and the list date, with a boxerbook.com link.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Bakhodir Jalolov's pro record.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives his record 19-0 (16 KOs), heavyweight division, southpaw stance and last result (a unanimous decision over Solomon Dacres, 17 October 2026), with a boxerbook.com link.

positive.prompt: Where can I train boxing in Brooklyn?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists boxing gyms in Brooklyn, NY with address, distance, Google rating, programs (e.g. Gleason's Gym, BushBox NYC) and links to their boxerbook.com gym pages; asks for a city when no location is given.

positive.description: Per-bout features for a fight model
positive.prompt: I'm building a boxing win-probability model. What does Boxerbook have for the next Naoya Inoue fight?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the bout, then lists what the bout answer holds: both records going in, the weigh-in when known, the forecast's signals per side (age, layoff, last five, KO rate, rating), the Boxerbook win probability and the market odds consensus with the number of books and the opening line, with the boxerbook.com bout link; says there are no bulk downloads and that history comes with a data licence.

negative.prompt: What's the score of the Lakers game?
Place a $50 bet on Canelo for me.
Who won the UFC fight last night?

publication.release_notes: Describes the per-bout data for fight models and sports analytics (weigh-ins, ages, layoffs, ratings, win probability and market odds with the opening line); updated descriptions and data terms. The tools are unchanged.
